'''Toucanzam''' is a [[Lightning]] type [[Tank]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Buzzbeak]] at 18 stars, and evolves into [[Technocan]] at 36 stars after completing their [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Toucanzam's song is said to be more than just a song, but a means of communicating with others of the same kind. Which means it is a language only Toucanzam can understand. Would love to know what it is all about!"

Toucanzam is a red rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
Toucanzam is a mostly blueish Toucan, with a white face and yellow lightning-inspired highlights on its wings and tail. Its tail fans out like a peacock's. It has lighter blue three-toed feet, and a large, orange and yellow bill.

Toucanzam's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form changes its orange and yellow bill into magenta and pink.

== Evolution Trial ==
Toucanzam's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 36 stars. To evolve it into [[Technocan]] you need to complete the following three tasks:
* Feed this Tatari to B quality.
* Play [[Events#Marathon Party|Marathon Party]] (use skateboard x6000) or [[Fishing Contest]] (use Fishing Rod x6000).
* In [[Zobo Horde Invasion|Horde Invasion]], upgrade Toucanzam to Lvl. 7 or above for a total of 5 time(s).

==Trivia==
* Toucanzam's name is inspired by the toucan bird and the phrase "Shazam". This phrase was made popular by a superhero who summons a bolt of lightning when he says his name, Shazam.
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Toucanzam likes to say 'Follow your nose! Wherever it grows!' Researchers don't know what it means."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Toucanzam has a full repertoire of songs with powerful effects. Depending on friend or foe, they can either soothe the mind or shatter glass."

==Strategy==
[[File:Toucanzam Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Toucanzam's attack range]]
Toucanzam functions mostly the same as its pre-evolution Buzzbeak. However, the differences are that it has slightly higher stats as well as a new ability to Supercharge the linked Lightning type allies. It is still unknown how effective the "Supercharged: ATK Boost" status is, compared to its normal counterpart.
